package.description: Rapidly scan, preview, sort, organise and convert large video and image collections.

en-GB.description: Rapidly scan, preview, sort, organise and convert large video and image collections.
en-GB.longDescription:
Resolution File Manager is a dual-pane media manager for large video and image
collections. Scan folders and subfolders, preview media, compare duplicates,
and sort or filter by codec, resolution, size, duration, bitrate, frame rate,
date, rating, label and tags. It also supports user-selected copy, move, rename,
Recycle Bin and media-conversion workflows, including H.264, H.265 and AV1.
en-GB.name: Resolution File Manager
